stories.title: Solana Developers Propose Major Overhaul to Fix Hidden Network Risk
stories.summary: Solana developers proposed a major overhaul to the protocol. The plan targets a hidden risk that could disrupt the network. CryptoSlate reported the proposal on November 5. The report did not give full technical details on the risk.
stories.whyItMatters: A core protocol fix affects the reliability of one of the largest layer-1 blockchains, which matters to developers and holders alike.
whatToWatch: Whether the proposal moves to a formal vote
Technical details on the specific risk
Response from validators and core developers
questions: What exactly is the hidden risk?
How soon could the fix ship?

sources.title: Solana developers propose major overhaul to address hidden risk that could disrupt its network

stories.title: Gate's 104% Cold Reserve Claim Questioned Over Mismatched Snapshot Dates
stories.summary: Exchange Gate reported 104% cold reserve coverage, meaning it says it holds more assets in cold storage than it owes users. CryptoSlate noted the reserve and liability figures came from separate snapshot dates. That gap makes the comparison harder to verify.
stories.whyItMatters: Proof-of-reserve reports are meant to rebuild trust after past exchange collapses, so a methodology gap weakens the claim's value.
whatToWatch: Whether Gate aligns snapshot dates in future reports
Any independent audit of the reserve ratio
questions: Why were the two snapshots taken on different dates?
Does the mismatch change the real coverage ratio?

sources.title: Gate boasts 104% cold reserve coverage, but separate snapshot dates raise red flags

stories.title: Strategy's $100 STRC Offering Could Fund New Bitcoin Buys
stories.summary: Strategy is reviving its STRC preferred stock offering at $100 a share. CryptoSlate reports the raise could offset cash outflows and give the company fresh capital for more Bitcoin purchases. Strategy has used several debt and equity tools to keep growing its Bitcoin holdings.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy is one of the largest corporate Bitcoin holders, so its financing moves can signal new buy-side demand for the asset.
whatToWatch: Size and investor uptake of the STRC offering
Confirmation that proceeds go toward Bitcoin purchases
Strategy's next disclosed Bitcoin buy
questions: How much capital will the offering actually raise?
Does repeated reliance on capital markets raise risk?

sources.title: Strategy’s $100 STRC comeback could turn a cash drain into fresh Bitcoin buying power

stories.title: Bitcoin's $2.7 Billion Friday Options Expiry Carries a Five-Hour Blind Spot
stories.summary: Bitcoin traders are watching Friday's $2.7 billion options expiry. CryptoSlate flagged a five-hour window around the event with reduced market visibility, which raises the risk of sharp price moves. Large expiries like this have coincided with volatility before.
stories.whyItMatters: An expiry this size can swing the spot price fast, which affects anyone holding or trading Bitcoin around that date.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin's price action into and through Friday's expiry
Whether the five-hour gap produces unusual volatility
questions: What causes the five-hour blind spot?
How concentrated is positioning around key strike prices?

sources.title: Bitcoin traders face Friday’s $2.7 billion options expiry with a dangerous five-hour blind spot

stories.title: Optimism Proposal Would Curb Council's Power Over Standalone Chains
stories.summary: A new governance proposal in the Optimism ecosystem would reduce the Security Council's authority over standalone chains built on its stack. CryptoSlate reported the plan on November 6. The change would shift control away from centralized oversight for chains that run independently of the core Optimism collective.
stories.whyItMatters: Governance structure sets how much autonomy and risk standalone chains carry, which affects developers and users building on Optimism.
whatToWatch: A community vote or discussion period on the proposal
Reaction from standalone chain operators
questions: Which standalone chains are most affected?
What oversight, if any, replaces the council's current role?

sources.title: Optimism new proposal weakens council power over standalone chains

stories.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $76,000 as AI Bubble Fears Erase $2.5 Trillion From Wall Street
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $76,000 as fears of an AI stock bubble wiped roughly $2.5 trillion from Wall Street. CryptoSlate reported the decline on November 5 and linked it to the broader equity sell-off. The move shows Bitcoin still trades in step with risk sentiment in stock markets.
stories.whyItMatters: A sharp, correlated drop shows Bitcoin still behaves like a risk asset tied to equities, not as an independent hedge.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin stabilizes or falls further below $76,000
Follow-through selling in AI-linked tech stocks
Any shift in the Bitcoin-equity correlation
questions: How much of the drop is AI-sector contagion versus crypto-specific selling?
Could the sell-off trigger further leveraged liquidations?

sources.title: Bitcoin crashes below $76,000 as AI bubble fears wipe $2.5 trillion from Wall Street

stories.title: Treasury's $6 Billion Bond Buyback Draws Skepticism From Dealers
stories.summary: The U.S. Treasury bought back $6 billion in bonds. Bond dealers say the operation is too small to ease market strains. CryptoSlate reported the dealer pushback on November 5.
stories.whyItMatters: Treasury market liquidity and rate conditions shape the risk appetite that flows into Bitcoin and other crypto assets.
whatToWatch: Whether Treasury increases the size of future buybacks
Bond market liquidity conditions in coming weeks
questions: What specific strains are dealers pointing to?
Could larger buybacks shift crypto risk sentiment?

sources.title: Treasury bought back $6B in bonds, but dealers say bigger isn’t enough

stories.title: Circle's $182 Million Token Sale Masks a Decline in USDC Revenue
stories.summary: Circle raised $182 million through a token sale. CryptoSlate reports the raise masks weaker core revenue from its USDC stablecoin business. The sale appears to offset softer underlying performance rather than reflect new strength.
stories.whyItMatters: USDC is one of the largest stablecoins, so a weaker revenue base at Circle has implications for stablecoin market stability and competition.
whatToWatch: Circle's next earnings disclosure
USDC market share against competing stablecoins
questions: What is driving the USDC revenue decline?
Is the token sale a one-time offset or a recurring strategy?

sources.title: Circle’s $182 million crypto token sale masks revenue decline as USDC business weakens

stories.title: South Korea Weighs Another Delay to Its 22% Crypto Tax
stories.summary: South Korean officials are considering a new delay to the country's planned 22% crypto tax. CryptoSlate reports the plan would also give investors a new break on losses. The tax has already faced repeated delays amid industry pushback.
stories.whyItMatters: Tax policy directly shapes trading activity in South Korea, one of the world's most active retail crypto markets.
whatToWatch: Formal legislative action on the delay
A new effective date, if one is set
Details of the proposed loss break
questions: How many times has this tax now been delayed?
What is driving continued resistance to implementation?

sources.title: South Korea wants to delay its 22% crypto tax again and give investors a new break on losses

stories.title: India Warns AI-Assisted Hackers Are Targeting Crypto Wallet Keys
stories.summary: Indian authorities warned that hackers are using AI tools to steal crypto wallet keys. CryptoSlate reported the warning on November 5. The report did not detail specific attack methods or victim numbers.
stories.whyItMatters: Wallet key theft causes irreversible loss of funds, so new AI-assisted attack methods raise the stakes for personal crypto security.
whatToWatch: Any official security guidance India releases
Reports of incidents tied to this threat
questions: How widespread are these attacks so far?
What specific techniques are the hackers using?

sources.title: India warns AI-assisted hackers are stealing crypto wallet keys
